annotations.text:
The whole product is one sentence: I need something -> show me who can do it -> contact them now.
Every screen left to right is one step of that. Nothing else competes for the primary action.

Signature element: the need-bar.
What / where / open-now collapsed into one card so the whole decision happens in a single glance, before any scrolling.

"What we checked" sits above the fold's fold, with dates and one honest gap (no liability cover).
A badge nobody can interrogate is worth nothing.
Leads come first on the dashboard, not vanity stats. The upgrade sits at the bottom and cites a real number (421 searches), so it reads as useful rather than as a pitch.
The "People are searching for" grid is the SEO engine made visible - one indexable page per category x suburb, which is how a directory actually gets traffic.
